title: Macronix bets on 3D NAND and NOR as bigger rivals retreat from low-capacity markets
html: Macronix International is betting on 3D NAND and 3D NOR flash memory to drive its next phase of growth as major global memory manufacturers withdraw from low- and mid-capacity markets, leaving opportunities in automotive and other specialty applications.
